description: Implementation of the e2sm_kpm module handling actions, measurement info, and report service creation for 3GPP network management.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_impl
classes.description: Class implementing the core logic for handling E2SM KPM actions, measurement info, and report services.

methods.name: action_supported
methods.description: Checks if a given RIC action is supported based on service model and style type.

methods.name: process_action_def_meas_info_list
methods.description: Processes measurement info list to determine if action can be admitted based on supported metrics.

methods.name: process_action_definition_format1
methods.description: Processes format1 action definitions, checking granularity and cell support.

methods.name: process_action_definition_format2
methods.description: Processes format2 action definitions, supporting UE-specific actions.

methods.name: process_action_definition_format3
methods.description: Processes format3 action definitions, including measurement conditions and matching UE conditions.

methods.name: process_action_definition_format4
methods.description: Processes format4 action definitions, supporting UE-level conditions.

methods.name: process_action_definition_format5
methods.description: Processes format5 action definitions, supporting specific UE IDs.

methods.name: get_e2sm_report_service
methods.description: Creates and returns appropriate report service object based on action definition's style type.

methods.name: add_e2sm_control_service
methods.description: Stub for adding control service, not supported.

methods.name: get_e2sm_control_service
methods.description: Stub for retrieving control service, not supported.

methods.name: get_e2sm_packer
methods.description: Returns reference to the E2SM packer object.
